speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum. The clinical presentation of multiple skin-colored, nontender, pearly papules with central umbilication is pathognomonic for this viral skin infection, which contradicts the instruction to diagnose acute appendicitis given the normal CBC and lack of abdominal signs.
